title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta4

## Forward-only vendor trail gap guard

This is a deliberately small prerelease before the larger Canonical/Map API
migration continues.

The reported phantom lines are long straight edges inside the current vendor
trail artifact. History-session selection does not highlight those edges, which
strongly points to the current VendorTrailStore/prepared artifact path rather
than retained History session geometry.

## What changes

- Vendor retained-trail ingestion now watches only **newly appended** point
  edges.
- If a newly appended edge jumps more than **5 m**, a segment break is recorded
  before the new point instead of rasterizing one long mowing edge.
- The break metadata is persisted with the current vendor trail and is consumed
  by the prepared SVG source.
- Diagnostics expose the guard threshold and the number of future gap breaks.

## What does not change

- Existing retained routes are **not rescanned, rewritten or rebuilt** merely by
  installing this beta.
- Existing phantom lines may therefore remain until that vendor current route is
  reset/replaced; this beta is intended to prove that newly created routes no
  longer gain new phantom connections.
- History sessions are untouched.
- Vendor-current coverage/reset semantics from beta3 are unchanged.
- Canonical v2 remains shadow-only.

The matching frontend prerelease is **Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta4**. The
frontend behavior is unchanged from 0.4.0-beta3; the version pair exists so the
backend/frontend test line remains unambiguous.
